summary: Add a read-only fixed-question retrieval benchmark that compares immutable Canonical graph revisions using locked answer atoms without exposing evidence text or making model calls.
decision_refs: Active user objective to continue optimizing CIRP and improve correctness
Kapolei product-path validation attributing most sampled failures to retrieval and fragmented structural context
approval_evidence: The user directed continued correctness optimization after the Canonical V2 and drawing-structure slice passed all offline gates.
known_limitations: The benchmark measures whether locked answer atoms appear in the bounded retrieval context; it does not score model synthesis or final answer validity.
Existing evidence created by an older parser cannot gain missing Sheet or table-row locators from an index-only rebuild and may require a full reparse into a new database.
No customer evidence text, credential, provider response or paid call is emitted by the benchmark.
